question: Are the operator and observer identities consistent under weighted nonunitary frame transformations?
source_equations: docs/research/gross-test-01.md: bounded sampling and residual definitions

method.action: No evolution action; Hermitian operator constitution only, prerequisite shared by SS OPS 1 and SS OCF 1.
method.units: Matrices, state weights and residuals dimensionless; near-collinearity angles radians.
method.domain: 1000 random moderate-condition samples, tetrahedral projectors, fixed boost control and 10 near/singular aggregates.
method.boundaries: No spatial domain or time integration. Conditioning, not mesh/domain/timestep, is the numerical control.
method.initial_data: Root seed 2026092501; PCG64 with runtime sampling stream. Standard-normal Pauli coefficients and complex constituents; condition <=100; independent SU(2)-boost-SU(2), rapidity in [-1,1].
method.solver: Registered direct-matrix-v1 batch with independent saved-input Pauli-component analysis; single-thread BLAS.
method.tolerances: Scale-normalized valid-domain residual <1e-10; positivity >0; negative omitted-weight error >1e-3. No hidden singular-value regularization.

hypotheses.prediction: Valid samples obey identities, exact Gram spectrum and observer positivity; singular and broken-weight controls are detected.
One or more valid-domain identities exceed threshold, positivity fails, or invalid-domain/weight controls escape detection.

controls.method: Read all raw matrices and compare worker scalars with independent real component formulas.

controls.purpose: Check the exact algebraic Lorentzian signature
controls.method: Compare computed Gram matrix eigenvalues to (-1/3,-1/3,-1/3,1).

controls.purpose: Expose invalid observer domains and omitted boost weights
controls.method: Rank-one and near-collinear aggregates plus a deterministic rapidity-one boost with and without weight transformation.

prohibited_inferences: This is algebra/implementation validation, not physical Lorentz covariance, propagation, emergent spacetime or a clock.
No dynamics means conservation, boundary sensitivity and discretization convergence are not evaluated.
Finite seeds do not prove identities or justify ill-conditioned observer normalization.
